description: Myrias instant read. Reads 2-5 variants against a census-weighted synthetic population for a market, in seconds, and returns each variant's predicted action propensity, its lift over the control, and which demographic archetypes favour it. A variant can be copy (text), a live page (url), an image (image_path, image_url or image_base64) or a video (video_path). Media reads are single-kind: images or videos cannot be mixed with copy, pages or each other. The first read of a new image takes about 30-45 s and may come back running (collect it with aetherya_get_result). A video is uploaded and prepared first, about 1-2 min. Much cheaper and faster than aetherya_test_copy, which is the deeper follow-up. Counts against the monthly read allowance, not simulation sessions. Results are SIMULATED, not real-user data.

audience.description: Read against a saved audience (persona group id from aetherya_list_audiences) instead of a market.

market.description: Who to read against, as a place: 'United States', 'Germany', 'RO'. Defaults to the US.

target_action.description: The action the variants should drive, e.g. 'Sign up'.

title.description: Optional name for the read in your run history.

variants.description: 2-5 variants to read side by side. Images and videos are read on their own, not mixed with other kinds.

image_path.description: Local png, jpeg or webp file (disabled when AETHERYA_MCP_ALLOW_LOCAL_FILES=0).

is_control.description: The current/baseline variant. Exactly one; defaults to the first.

label.description: Optional short name for this variant.

url.description: A live page to read, http or https.

video_path.description: Local mp4, mov, m4v or webm file (disabled when AETHERYA_MCP_ALLOW_LOCAL_FILES=0).

where.description: Where the variants appear. Defaults to 'Landing page'.

name: aetherya_read
title: Instant read: which variant lands with a market
